settings.name: repository-mapping
settings.description: Repository mapping: the rows an owner hub holds, the lifecycle a repository moves through, and the meta mapping that reads several hubs without copying them.
settings.notes: Drawn 2026-10-18 with the first implementation (@medicine-wheel/developer-repository-mapping and @medicine-wheel/capabilities, suite 0.21.0). Decomposition: .pde/2610182156--872139f0-b71c-4e94-9781-a5546182e3c1 in jgwill/medicine-wheel.

actors.name: Person
actors.description: Whoever the repositories belong to, or a reader they trust. Affirms rows; registers hubs; decides what a career-facing hub shows.

actors.name: MappingAgent
actors.description: A model session reading repositories. Its output is assumed biased until a person reads it, so every row it writes is pending.

actors.name: Cli
actors.description: mw-repomap: init, validate, list, show, observe, move, hub, serve, wheel.

actors.name: OwnerHub
actors.description: A <owner>/<owner> repository holding .miadi/repository-mapping/ for that owner's repositories.

actors.name: MetaHub
actors.description: jgwill/jgwill: an owner hub that also registers other hubs in owners.jsonl and reads them.
